column1: # The authored compile census's expectations: one line per committed authored
# case, its id, then its cell on each profile-leg of the header: `compiled`, or the executor's
# stable refusal label, followed by ` uncovered=N` when N of the case's command buffers are
# host-replayed there (pipelines the census does not compile). On a C3 venue's profile-leg, a
# compiled cell with nothing uncovered is followed by ` artifact=SHA256`, the digest of what a
# run of the case executes there, computed at the build the `artifacts_at` line names. Written
# only by `corpus-triage --audit authored-compile --bless` or `--bless-additions`; a merge
# conflict here is resolved by blessing again at the merged tree, never by taking a side.
